<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About us:</strong></p>
<p>Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients.&nbsp; Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.</p></div><p><strong>Duties &amp; Responsibilities:</strong><br>● Responsible for developing and supporting data pipelines that support and enable the<br>overall strategy of expanded data programs, services, process optimization, and<br>advanced business intelligence<br>● Design and develop scalable data warehousing solutions, building ETL pipelines in Big<br>Data environments (cloud, on-prem, hybrid)<br>● Leading data discovery sessions with business teams, comprising product owners, data<br>analysts, and cross-team technologists to understand enterprise data requirements of<br>analytics projects<br>● Ensure proper testing and monitoring are in place to provide trusted and reliable data<br>from the data stack.<br>● Partner with business domain experts, system analysts, data/application architects, and<br>development teams to ensure data design is aligned with business strategy and direction<br>● Identify and document standard methodologies, standards, and architecture guidelines<br>● Dive deep, as required, to assist Business Intelligence Engineers through technical<br>hurdles impacting delivery<br>● Participating in a shared on-call rotation monitoring the health of the team’s systems<br><br><strong>Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:</strong><br><br>● 3+ years of data architecture related experience such as data analysis, data modeling,<br>and data integration.<br>● 5+ years of Experience in custom ETL design, implementation, and maintenance<br>● Advanced Knowledge of programming languages (e.g. Python and Object Oriented<br>Programming)<br>● Hands-on experience with SQL database design<br>● Experience working on Cloud Platforms (AWS or Google )<br>● Experience working on CI/CD processes and source control tools such as GitHub and<br>GitLab<br>● Experience working with relational databases (Snowflake, Redshift)<br>● Strong knowledge of orchestration tools (AirFlow Preferred), file storage systems(AWS<br>S3, Google Cloud Storage), partitioning, and real-time processing of data<br>● Strong knowledge and experience with Agile/Scrum methodology and iterative practices<br>in a service delivery lifecycle<br>● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to influence<br>a large organization<br>● Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related<br>field<br><br><strong>Bonus Points: ( specific project )</strong><br><br>● Experience working with reporting tools such as Tableau<br>● Experience with event streaming with modern event streaming toolings like Kafka or<br>&nbsp; &nbsp;Kinesis.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Tech Holding is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, and we consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. If you require accommodation in the application process, please contact our HR&nbsp;</p></div>
